supports: multipletests performs test results and p-value correction for multiple tests; holm is the step-down method using Bonferroni adjustments; procedures control the family-wise error rate in the independent case and are robust in the positively correlated case.

supports: Binary log loss is negative y log(p) plus (1-y) log(1-p); logarithm is natural.
